key_insight: This Perspective proposes Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS) to build collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning experiences rather than raw data or model parameters.
clinical_relevance: DAS could help healthcare institutions learn from diverse clinical experiences and adapt AI support to longitudinal care.
method: Connect distributed AI agents across healthcare institutions.
Exchange structured reasoning trajectories: observations, hypotheses, tool use, and outcome feedback.
Aggregate experiences rather than numerical model updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework and discusses deployment and governance, but reports no datasets, empirical evaluation, or clinical outcomes.
watch_item: Sharing abstracted reasoning still requires privacy safeguards and validation before clinical deployment.
paper_title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
